text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And so it begins—this year's Spring Fan
Fest!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
It's neck-and-neck in the Tracen marathon!
Who will be first to the
academy gates and
past the finish line?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Okay, everyone. Our next cheer is "Fight
on!" Let's support the racers
with our best
cheering voices! Ready, and—

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Fight on!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
First place is in! Followed closely by the
pack! And with that, the last
racer is firmly
past the finish line!

text_block_list.name: Cat-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Hehe! King, thank you for your support! I actually finished! Your cheers helped me keep running!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't only me cheering. All the fans
here cheered for you to make
it across the
finish line!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Congrats! You did it!
What an inspiring
feat!

text_block_list.name: Cat-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...Hehe, you're right. I didn't realize I
had so many people
cheering me on!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Well, you do. Let that sink in. Now...
Cheer Squad, assemble! We're
moving on
to the next competition!

text_block_list.name: Nature and Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hooray! Hooray! Tracen!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, this year's Fan Fest is a blast as
always! Even the people cheering
look like
they're having lots of fun.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You're welcome to join! ♪ I can sense
you've got cheer spirit! Feel
free to shout
out anytime!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Uh, uhh... B-but... I don't know the chants
or anything...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Not to worry! I'll teach you the chants, and
you can just follow along!
Let's enjoy
ourselves! ♪ C'mon!

text_block_list.name: Pearl and Spectator
text_block_list.text: Oh, Tracen! Tracen! Go!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, even the cheers sound exciting!
Maybe I'll try shouting
something!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Please do! I'll give you some lyric
cards if you like, so have fun
cheering with
us right up till the end!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
This year's Fan Fest seems to have loud
cheers everywhere you go.

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: I know, right? It's got me joining in too!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
(...Everyone watching has a twinkle in their
eyes. Wow... King's done a
great job with
the Cheer Squad!)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: King, I promise...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I will see this race through to the end! No
matter how hard it gets... I'll
be just like
you!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I will give the fans a race to go wild about!

text_block_list.name: Fan Fest Committee
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! All participants of the
4,000-meter scavenger hunt
obstacle
race, we have an important update to
share!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
This afternoon, there'll be a lot of events
going on at the same time.
There's the
cycling race by the school gates, and the
quiz run in the
gym...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I think we'll have no choice but to split up.
Can I leave the cycling
race with you and
Pearl?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Okay. So you'll be at the gym? After that,
we have the 4,000-meter
scavenger hunt
obstacle race, so let's meet at the track.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Kiiing! I picked up some lost property for
the Cheer Squad as I was
patrolling
around!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ah! S-sorry! We've been rushing around all
day...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Sounds like you could do with some deep
breaths! That's what I did
last year. I was
told to calm down and take deep breaths!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Nature, we should start heading over soon.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Oh, sorry. Well, we'll be off, then!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Okay, good luck! All right, everyone. Time
to split up! Let's go to our
respective
events and cheer with the fans!

text_block_list.name: Cheer Squad
text_block_list.text: Osu!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for lending your wisdom! I hope
you'll be watching over us
as we cheer!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yup! Heh, look at you, getting more
dependable!

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Member
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, Captain! I found this lost
property while I was doing my
rounds!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oh, this is...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...They really have been rushing around,
huh. Guess I'll take a little
detour. Hm?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hooray! Hooray! Go, Tracen! Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
(Gahhh, this is so embarrassing! But our
captain trusted me with this,
so I have to
at least try and see it through properly!)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, between races, don't forget to
hydrate and refuel with
some sugar! We
don't want anyone to faint.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
This is an announcement from the Fan Fest
Committee. Concerning
the 4,000-meter
scavenger hunt obstacle race scheduled
for 1:30
p.m...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Isn't that...
